services.name: Men's Precision Beard Styling & Trim

reviews.name: Sunita Verma
reviews.comment: Visited Siya Galaxy Salon right near pillar 33 for hair straightening and botoplex treatment. The staff is exceptionally polite and the salon is spotless and spacious. Genuinely great value in Laxmi Nagar!

reviews.name: Aman Arora
reviews.comment: Got a haircut and beard grooming done here. The stylist really understands modern hair trends and takes his time. Very hygienic, welcoming, and budget friendly.

reviews.name: Priya Malhotra
reviews.comment: Had my engagement makeup and bridal gel nail extensions done here. Truly professional work! Everyone at the party was complimenting my look. The air-conditioned salon is clean and peaceful.

reviews.name: Meenakshi Sharma
reviews.comment: Super polite staff, welcoming atmosphere, and transparent pricing without hidden charges. The Hydra facial and hair spa were extremely relaxing. Highly recommended salon in East Delhi.

reviews.name: Deepak Saxena
reviews.comment: Clean environment, experienced stylists, and quick service right next to Laxmi Nagar Metro Station. They use genuine products and ensure customer satisfaction.

bookings.notes: Special event coming up, prefers gentle scalp touch.
